Definition: Five-character code for the source volume: BARMM, LDS, MDN, MDS, SGA.
The table, exhibit or annex label as printed in the source volume.
The numbered section and subsection in which the item sits.
The page number carried by that report's own contents list for the section or subsection in which the item sits.
Basis and source layer: Source document contents list, as at the export date.

Definition: Resident population at the 2024 Census of Population, reference date 1 July 2024.
Basis and source layer: Layer A — Philippine Statistics Authority 2024 Census and PSGC.

Definition: Barangay count as carried by the volume's Annex A. Lanao del Sur uses the 1,159-node 2020 model geography.

Field / column: Barangays with / without a first-contact facility
Definition: Barangays carrying at least one registered first-contact service point. MDN and LDS count registered barangay health stations; MDS counts registered facilities of any type; SGA counts municipally enumerated service points.
Basis and source layer: Layer C — project-held DOH/NHFR facility extract; Layer E — municipal EBDM worksheet enumeration.
Fact, derived or assumption: Fact, definitions not commensurable across volumes

Definition: Rural health units as carried by Annex A. For SGA the register basis (9) is used; the operating basis is 6.
Basis and source layer: Layer C — DOH/NHFR extract, cross-checked against Layer E.

Definition: Licensed bed complement of all classes. The Lanao del Sur Annex A carries no bed column; bed data for that province sits on 14_Inpatient_Capacity from Table 6 and Table 6A.
Basis and source layer: Layer C — DOH-HFSRB licensing records as held by the project.

Definition: Fully immunised child coverage.
Basis and source layer: Layer B — FHSIS / draft 2024 BARMM LGU Health Scorecard.

Definition: Facility-based delivery.
Basis and source layer: Layer B — FHSIS / Scorecard; MDS value is a 2018 vintage.

Definition: Tuberculosis case notification rate per 100,000 population.
Basis and source layer: Layer B — national TB programme returns as carried by the volumes.

Definition: Notified cases as a share of expected incident cases.
Basis and source layer: Derived in the source volumes from notification against modelled incidence.

Definition: Adults risk-assessed under the Philippine Package of Essential NCD Interventions.
Stunting prevalence among children under five.
Population 2024 divided by rural health units held. Returns 'no RHU recorded' where the unit count is zero.
Basis and source layer: Computed in this workbook from columns F and J.

Definition: ROUNDUP(population / 20,000). The 1:20,000 figure is a planning target for catchment, not a licensing standard for facilities.
Implied units less units held, floored at zero.
Barangays with a first-contact facility divided by barangays.
Licensed beds divided by population, multiplied by 1,000.
The live recomputation less the figure printed in the source. A non-zero variance is a reconciliation item, not a correction.
LGU · Provincial or area total as annexed · Non-component reference. Only rows typed 'LGU' enter the roll-ups on 11_Jurisdiction_Rollup.
Basis and source layer: Assigned in this workbook from the annex row labels.
